title: Gayatri Mantra
translation: Om. Earth, sky, heaven. We meditate on the adorable radiance of the divine Savitar, the sun. May he inspire our minds.
translation_hi: ॐ। भू, भुवः, स्वः। हम सविता देव के उस वरणीय तेज का ध्यान करते हैं। वे हमारी बुद्धि को प्रेरित करें।

words.meaning: of Savitar, the sun as giver of life

science: Savitar is the sun as the source of life and energy. Almost all energy on Earth, from food to fossil fuels, wind and solar power, comes from sunlight.
